7001.name: Leap Attack
simple: Casts the skill and leaps up to the target spot to pummel the ground, dealing 228% Weapon Attack Damage to enemies within a certain area.
The skill grants the following buff upon consuming Demolisher Charge: Hitting enemies will increase the skill's Damage and Area.
details: Leap Attack:
Deals 228% Weapon Attack Damage.
This skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 4s.
This skill grants the following buff upon consuming Demolisher Charge: Gains a buff once for each enemy hit, up to 20 time(s).
The buff lasts 2s.
+20% damage to the skill per bonus gained
+10% Skill Area to the skill per bonus gained
-40% additional Attack Speed for this skill
75% of the bonuses for Movement Speed is also applied to the additional Attack Speed of the skill, up to +60% additional Attack Speed
The closer the jump distance, the faster the Base Attack Speed of this skill

7006.name: Hammer of Ash
simple: Casts the skill and pummels the ground in front, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
When pummeling, generates 3 auto-tracing Ember Projectiles, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
When the skill consumes Demolisher Charge, Embers cause explosion on hit, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
Demolisher Charge additionally increases the skill's damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Fire Damage.
details: Pummel:
Deals 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
Ember Projectile:
Deals 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +2
Projectiles fired by this skill cannot Penetrate, Jump, or Return
Explosion:
Deals 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
+215% additional Hit Damage when the skill consumes Demolisher Charge
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
The pummel and explosion caused by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%.

7028.name: Shadow Shot
simple: Casts the skill and fires 1 Shadow Shot that detonates on hit forward, dealing 564-846 Spell Erosion Damage.
The Shadow Shot can move the existing Shadow Swamp.
details: Shadow Shot:
Deals 564-846 Spell Erosion Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Explosion:
Deals 564-846 Spell Erosion Damage.
The skill moves an existing Shadow Swamp to the target's location on hit. The Interval of this effect is 0.5s

7029.name: Shadow Swamp
simple: Casts the skill and generates Erosion Explosion at the target spot, dealing 401-401 Spell Erosion Damage to enemies within a certain area.
The Erosion Explosion will leave a Swamp Terra afterwards, dealing 546 Persistent Erosion Damage to enemies in it. The Swamp Terra lasts 6s.
The Swamp Terra can be moved by Shadows. After that, there will be another Erosion Explosion and the duration will be refreshed.
details: Explosion:
Deals 401-401 Spell Erosion Damage.
Swamp Terra:
Swamp Terra lasts for 6s
Deals 546 Persistent Erosion Damage every second for 2s
The skill can only generate 1 Terra
Enemies on a Swamp Terra are Weakened
On hit, Shadow Shot moves the existing Swamp Terra to the location of the hit and causes another explosion
Each movement grants +10% additional Skill Area for the Swamp Terra
Stacks up to 1 time(s)
For every stack of Terra Charge consumed, the Swamp Terra gains an additional effect every time it moves: +26% additional Damage Over Time (does not apply to Ailment Damage)
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
The maximum stacks of Terra Charge are 1
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s

7030.name: Marked Rain of Arrows
simple: Casts the skill and fires a Marked Arrow, dealing 35% Weapon Attack Damage on hit. The Marked Arrow has a chance to Mark the enemy.
When the Marked Arrow marks the enemy or hits a Marked enemy, channels down 5 Explosive Arrows around the enemy with each Explosive Arrow dealing 162% Weapon Attack Damage.
details: Marked Arrow:
Deals 35% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
+100% chance for the Marked Arrows to Mark the enemy on hit
The Projectile is not affected by Projectile Quantity bonuses.
Projectiles fired by this skill cannot Jump or Penetrate
Explosive Arrow:
Deals 162% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +4
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
The Explosive Arrows fired by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%.
Projectiles from this skill cannot Jump
Projectiles from this skill cannot Penetrate

7044.name: Charged Pummel
simple: Pummels the ground at the end of the skill channeling, dealing 438% Weapon Attack Damage.

The skill will generate an Electric Field at the spot pummeled when consuming Demolisher Charge, continuously hitting the enemies within the field for a period of time and dealing 22% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consumingDemolisher Charge, Each channeled stack additionally increases the Damage of the Pummel cast that time and extends the Base Duration of the Electric Field.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Lightning Damage.
details: Pummel:
Deals 438% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consuming Demolisher Charge, 70% additional Hit Damage for the Pummel per channeled stacks.
Electric Field:
Deals 22% Weapon Attack Damage.
The Electric Field lasts 2s.
Each channeled stack grants +0.2s Electric Field Duration.
The Electric Field deals damage once every 0.3s
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Lightning Damage
+100% additional Attack Speed for this skill
The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
Max channeled stacks: 5
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled

7052.name: Flame Slash
simple: Launches a Sweep Slash to attack the fan-shaped area in front, dealing 346% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.

This skill is affected by Steep Strike chance and may be cast in Steep Strike form. When it launches a Steep Strike, it generates 3 flames, dealing 346% Weapon Attack Damage on hit. The Skill Area will increase the number of flames generated by a Steep Strike. Multiple flames can hit the same enemy at once.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Fire Damage.
details: Sweep Slash:
Deals 346% Weapon Attack Damage.
Steep Strike:
Deals 346% Weapon Attack Damage.
For every 115% Area bonus for this skill, the number of fire torrents +2.
For every 115% Area bonus for this skill, the distance of fire torrents +30%.
The damage from multiple fire torrents can be stacked.
This skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 50%
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
This skill +20% Steep Strike chance.

7053.name: Icy Blade
simple: Launches a Sweep Slash to attack the fan-shaped area in front, dealing 142% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.

This skill is affected by Steep Strike chance and may be cast in Steep Strike form. When it launches a Steep Strike, it generates 1 Icy Blade, dealing 142% Weapon Attack Damage on hit. Upon hitting a Frozen enemy with this skill, gains a Steep Strike attempt. Causes an explosion when Steep Strike hits a Frozen enemy, dealing 213% Weapon Attack Damage. Multiple explosions and Steep Strikes can hit the same enemy.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Cold Damage.

7054.name: Frost Spike
simple: Casts this skill and thrusts forward, dealing 201% Weapon Attack Damage.
Fires 2 Icy Blades on hit, dealing 201% Weapon Attack Damage.
The enemy's Frostbite Rating will both increase this skill's damage and the number of Icy Blades fired by this skill.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Cold Damage.
details: Thrust:
Deals 201% Weapon Attack Damage.
Icy Blade:
Deals 201% Weapon Attack Damage.
Fires 2 Projectiles in its base state
+1 Projectile Quantity when this skill hits an enemy with at least 60 Frostbite Rating
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Cold Damage
+10% additional damage when this skill hits an enemy with at least 30 Frostbite Rating
This skill's Projectile Quantity is not affected by bonuses
+8% additional Damage for every +1 Projectile Quantity of this skill
100% of the increase or decrease on Skill Area is also applied to the Tracking Area of this skill's Shadows, up to 100%

7057.name: Corrosive Shot
simple: Casts the skill and tosses a Corrosive Shot, which explodes upon contacting the target, dealing 95% Weapon Attack Damage.

The Corrosive Shot also generates a Corrosion Terra if it contacts the target before splitting, dealing 57 Persistent Erosion Damage every second to enemies on it and additionally increasing the damage enemies take from this skill while on it.
This skill deals increased Wilt Damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Erosion Damage.
details: Explosion:
Deals 95% Weapon Attack Damage.
+30% chance to Wilt
+30% additional Wilt Damage for this skill
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Erosion Damage
Corrosion Terra:
Corrosion Terra lasts for 3s.
Deals 57 Persistent Erosion Damage every second for 2s.
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
Terra Charge cannot be consumed until the Terra Charge of this skill is full
The maximum stack of Terra Charge is 1.
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s.
For every stack of Terra Charge consumed, this skill +26% additional damage dealt to enemies on the Terra

7060.name: Corrosive Throw
simple: Casts the skill and fires 3 Projectiles forward, dealing 383% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill 20 Multistrike chance, and the skill fires more Projectiles during Multistrike.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Erosion Damage.
details: Corrosive Throw:
Deals 383% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +2
+20% Multistrike Chance for this skill
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Erosion Damage

Every time this skill Multistrikes, gains 1 stack of buff. +1 Projectile Quantity for each stack of the buff, up to 3 , which is reset when Multistrike ends. The increased Projectile Quantity is affected by the Multistrike Count of the current skill
In general, the Projectiles shot by this skill cannot hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 87%.

7064.name: Savage Charge
simple: When channeling the skill, charges forward, passing through the enemies while moving, dealing 57% Weapon Attack Damage continuously, and knocking them back.

If the channeling of this skill stops at max channeled stacks, a Savage Strike will be launched, dealing 570% Weapon Attack Damage to the enemies in front and knocking them back. Demolisher Charge will grant additional damage to the attack.
Channeled stacks will increase the Skill Area of the skill when the character is charging using this skill.
details: Charge:
Deals 57% Weapon Attack Damage.
Savage Strike:
Deals 570% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consuming Demolisher Charge, this skill deals +90% additional Hit Damage.
On hit, the skill knocks back the enemy.
+100% additional Attack Speed for this skill
The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
Max channeled stacks: 5.
+12% Skill Area per channeled stack
The character will be forced to move forward when channeling the skill.
You can pass through enemies while channeling this skill

13.5% additional Erosion Damage
+10% Wilt chance
Adds 2 - 2 Base Wilt Damage

Every 1/10s, this skill gains 6.5 Focus Pts. Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, casting other skills will launch a Corrosion Orb that tracks enemies. When the Corrosion Orb is active, casting other skills will consume 50 Focus Pts and make the orb explode once, dealing 648 - 648 Spell Erosion Damage to enemies. Interval: 3/20s.
The orb is destroyed when Focus Pts drop to 0, its duration expires (2s), or it is 30m away from the character. Orb Quantity is not affected by Projectile Quantity.

7140.name: Ice Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
13.5% additional Cold Damage
Gains 30 Focus Pts when dealing damage to Frostbitten enemies. Interval: 0.4 s.

Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, creates an Ice Storm that follows the character. When there are enemies inside the storm, consumes 45 Focus Pts every 0.5 s to generate Glacial Spikes that deal Spell Cold Damage to the enemies
For every 1% Focus Speed, +1% Focus Pts gained, up to +200%. The Ice Storm ends when Focus Pts drop to 0.

7141.name: Thunder Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
13.5% additional Lightning Damage

For every 2m moved, this skill gains 5 Focus Pts. Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, using a non-Mobility Attack Skill will consume all Focus Pts and trigger this skill, summoning a Thunderstrike that deals 1109% Weapon Attack Damage to all enemies within a certain area.
When triggered by a Melee Skill, the Thunderstrike attacks a fan-shaped area. When triggered by a Ranged Skill, the Thunderstrike attacks a square-shaped area.
details: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
13.5% additional Lightning Damage
Thunder Focus:
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Lightning Damage
For every 2 m moved, the skill gains 5 Focus Pts
After this skill reaches 100 Focus Pts, using a non-Mobility Attack Skill will consume 100 Focus Pts and trigger this skill in front of you
Thunderstrike:
Deals 1109% Weapon Attack Damage.

7142.name: Flame Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
+7% additional Fire Damage
+10% chance to Ignite targets
Adds 2 - 2 Base Ignite Damage

This skill gains 15 Focus Pts when inflicting Ignite. Upon defeating an enemy, there is a 100% chance to consume 40 Focus Pts and trigger this skill on the enemy, dealing True Damage equal to 25% of their Max Life to enemies within 3m.
Additionally increases this skill's area for each time Ignite has been inflicted recently.
details: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
+7% additional Fire Damage
+10% chance to Ignite targets
Adds 2 - 2 Base Ignite Damage
Flame Focus:
This skill gains 15 Focus Pts when inflicting Ignite. This skill can be triggered up to 3 time(s) every 0.5 s

Upon defeating an enemy, there is a 100% chance to consume 40 Focus Pts of this skill and trigger this skill at the location of the defeated enemy, dealing True Damage equal to 25% of the defeated enemy's Max Life
+10% additional Skill Area for this skill for each time you inflict Ignite recently. Stacks up to 6 time(s)

Allies within the Safeguard Field gains the defensive effect: -8% additional damage taken and -10.5% additional damage taken from enemies outside the Safeguard Field.

The Sentry lasts 6.1s.
Skill's max base Sentry quantity is 1

-8% additional damage taken as the buff lasts
-20% additional damage dealt by enemies outside the circle as the buff lasts

7172.name: Howling Gale
simple: When channeling the skill, generates a Gale at the target spot, launching multiple strikes at enemies within a certain area with each strike dealing 548-913 Spell Physical Damage.
Each channeled stack extends Gale's Duration, additionally increases its damage, expands its Skill Area, and increases its Movement Speed.

Base Attack Frequency: 1.5

Each channeled stack increases Movement Speed for Gale.
This skill 21.5 % additional damage for every +1 additional Max Channeled Stack(s)

7175.name: Thunder Spike
simple: Casts the skill and thrusts forward, dealing 277% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill's Shadow Strike True Body inflicts 1 stack of Numbed on enemies within a certain area on hit. Interval: 1s.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Lightning Damage.
details: Thunder Spike:
Deals 277% Weapon Attack Damage.
When the skill's Shadow Strike True Body hits an enemy, it inflicts 1 stack of Numbed on enemies within 1000 m of the enemy hit. Interval: 1 s
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Lightning Damage
100% of the increase or decrease on Skill Area is also applied to the Tracking Area of this skill's Shadows, up to 100%

simple: Casts the skill and places 1 Ghost Blade Sentry, who will throw a Ghost Blade at 1 enemy within its range, dealing 93% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
The Sentry can Multistrike. Upon reaching the max Multistrike Count, this attack causes an explosion and deals 185% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
The number of Sentries placed grants Multistrike damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Erosion Damage.

The Sentry lasts 8s.
Skill's max base Sentry quantity is 1

Sentries placed by this skill can Multistrike
Multistrikes deal 15% increasing damage for every 1 Sentry(ies) deployed by this skill
Sentries placed by this skill can only attack again 1 s after launching a Multistrike
The interval is affected by Sentry Cast Frequency bonus

7181.name: Arrow Einherjar
simple: Casts the skill and places 1 Arrow Sentry at the target spot, who will shoot three arrows into the air. The arrows deal 135% Weapon Attack Damage to enemies within their range.
The Sentry placed by the skill deals additional damage every second.
Arrows shot by the Arrow Sentry are not affected by Projectile Quantity bonuses.
details: Arrow Einherjar:
Deals 135% Weapon Attack Damage.
The Base Sentry Cast Frequency is equal to 100% of average Weapon Attack Speed.
The Sentry lasts 8s.
The skill fires 3 Projectiles in its base state.
Skill's max base Sentry quantity is 1
Sentries placed by this skill gain 1 stack of buff every 1 s. Stacks up to 5 time(s)
-10% interval for every 1 Sentry(ies) placed by this skill
+8% additional Sentry Damage (multiplies) for every stack of buffs
Projectiles fired by the skill are not affected by Projectile Quantity bonuses.
The Projectiles shot by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%.

7197.name: Lightning Surge
simple: Casts the skill and fires a lightning bolt forward. The lightning bolt does not deal damage. As the lightning bolt travels, it unleashes a Chain of Lightning every 0.25s at up to 8 Nearby enemies, dealing 301% Base Damage as Attack Physical damage. Projectile Quantity bonuses do not increase the skill's Projectile Quantity but increase the number of enemies targeted by Chain of Lightning.
Lightning bolts always Penetrate.
details: Lightning Bolt:
Unleashes a Chain of Lightning every 0.25s at up to 8 Nearby enemies.
Projectile Quantity bonuses increase the number of enemies targeted by Chain of Lightning.
Projectile Quantity does not increase.
Projectiles from this skill always Penetrate
This skill's Projectile Speed bonus is fixed at 0
Chain of Lightning:
Deals Attack Physical Damage equal to 301% of Base Damage

The Projectiles fired by this skill can hit the same enemy.

7202.name: Speed Phantom
simple: Casts the skill and moves in the target direction, leaving behind a Remnant before and after moving, and inflicting Reversed Knockback on nearby enemies within a certain distance.
The Remnant explodes after 0.65s, dealing damage to enemies once. Gains 1 stack of Euphoria for each enemy hit:
For every 1 stack(s) of Euphoria, 2.5% additional Spell Damage, up to 8 stacks, lasting for 1.2s.
details: Remnant:
Remnant lasts 0.65s.
You can have up to 2 Remnant(s).
Remnant explosions deal 542-904 Spell Physical Damage on hit.
Gains 1 stack of Euphoria for each enemy hit by a Remnant explosion.
Euphoria:
For every 1 stack(s) of Euphoria, 2.5% additional Spell Damage, up to 8 stacks, lasting for 1.2s
Gains 1 stack of buff for each enemy hit with this skill, stacking up to 8 times
Knockback effect from this skill is reversed

7224.name: Serpent Beam
simple: Combo Starter 1: Fires a Fire Beam at an enemy, dealing 403-672 Spell Physical Damage and inflicting Serpent Bind.
Combo Starter 2: Fires a Fire Beam at an enemy that refracts 3 time(s), dealing 403-672 Spell Physical Damage and spreading the Serpent Bind from the enemy.
Combo Finisher: Fires a Finisher Fire Beam at an enemy, dealing 403-672 Spell Physical Damage to the target and all other enemies that have Serpent Bind. Consumes all Combo Points.
Converts all Physical Damage of this skill to Fire Damage.
details: Combo Starter 1:
Deals 403-672 Spell Physical Damage.
Inflicts Serpent Bind on hit
This skill is not affected by the number of refractions
When defeating an enemy, this skill spreads Serpent Bind from the enemy to other enemies within 5m
Combo Starter 2:
Deals 403-672 Spell Physical Damage
-15% Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Movement Speed for the enemy on hit for 2s
On hit, spreads the Serpent Bind from the target to other enemies within 5m
This skill can refract 3 time(s) in its base state
+1 additional refraction(s) for this skill's Combo Starters per +1 Beam(s)
Combo Finisher:
Deals 403-672 Spell Physical Damage
Deals damage to the target and all other enemies that have Serpent Bind
-33% additional Cast Speed for the Combo Finisher of this skill
+30% Combo Finisher Amplification for this skill
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
The Beam Quantity of this skill is not affected by the number of Beams

7225.name: Gale Slash
simple: Combo Starter 1: Charges forward, dealing 407% Weapon Attack Damage to enemies in the path.
Combo Starter 2: Launches a spinning attack while moving forward, dealing 407% Weapon Attack Damage.
Combo Finisher: Leaps and pummels the ground ahead, dealing 407% Weapon Attack Damage.
details: Combo Starter 1:
Deals 407% Weapon Attack Damage.
Charges forward 3.5m. If the enemy is too far away, instead charges 6m
+20% additional Attack Speed for the Combo Starter 1 of this skill
Combo Starter 2:
Deals 407% Weapon Attack Damage
Move forward 2.5m
When the Starter 2 hits, it knocks back enemies in the direction this skill was cast
Combo Finisher:
Deals 407% Weapon Attack Damage
Jump forward 4m
-50% additional Attack Speed for the Combo Finisher of this skill
+30% Combo Finisher Amplification for this skill
This skill's Attack Speed bonus falls off at a rate equal to that of a normal Mobility Skill
0.2% additional damage for this skill for every +1% Attack Speed
After casting this skill's Starter, gains 1 stack of Wind Wake for every 1 Combo Point(s) gained from the Starter
+5% movement distance for this skill's Starter for each current Combo Point. Stacks up to 4 time(s)
This skill cannot be triggered
This skill cannot be supported by Activation Medium Skills
1.5% additional Critical Strike Rating for this skill for each stack of buff

7342.name: Storm Field
simple: Casting this skill creates a Storm Field at the target location, generating Currents every second to deal 137-254 Spell Lightning Damage to enemies within the area. If the Currents hit 3 or more targets, creates a Thunderstrike that deals 205-380 Spell Lightning Damage to targets hit by the Currents. Currents can hit up to 8 target(s). For each target hit, this cast deals +3% additional Hit Damage. You and your Minions can also be targets of Currents but won't take any Hit Damage from them.

7343.name: Nether Grasp
simple: Casts this skill and creates a Nether Terra at the target location, dealing 468 Persistent Erosion Damage every second. Nether Terra creates a Nether Grasp periodically, Reverse Knocking Back enemies within a certain area to the Terra's central area.
Terra Charge additionally increases this skill's damage
details: Nether Terra:
Nether Terra lasts 6s
Deals 468 Persistent Erosion Damage every second for 2s
Reaping enemies in the central area of Nether Terra eliminates enemies under 10% Life
+26% additional damage for the skill for every Terra Charge consumed
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
Creates a Nether Grasp to hit enemies every 0.5s, dealing 37-37 Spell Erosion Damage and Reverse Knocking Back enemies toward the central area of Nether Terra
The maximum stacks of Terra Charge are 1
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s
This skill's max base Terra quantity is 1.

7355.name: Stasis Vault
simple: 持续 8 秒，冷却 16 秒，不受充能点数影响。
以发条核心为中心，展开半径 10 米的静滞天穹，持续对领域内的敌人施加减速。
对技能范围加成的 50% 作用于该技能的范围，上限 140%。
持续期间，被发条核心辅助的投射物技能必定穿透。
持续期间，被发条核心辅助的投射物技能触碰墙壁或天穹时触发召还。
details: Lasts 8s. Cooldown: 16s. Unaffected by Charges
Deploys a Stasis Vault with a radius of 10m centered around Clockwork Core, continuously inflicting Slow on enemies in the area
对技能范围加成的 50% 作用于该技能的范围，上限 140%
While this is active, Projectile Skills supported by Clockwork Core always Penetrate
While this is active, Projectile Skills supported by Clockwork Core trigger Recall when touching walls or the vault

durations.source: Lasts 8s. Cooldown: 16s. Unaffected by Charges

7356.name: Supreme Descent
simple: 冷却时间 3.3 秒，不受充能点数影响。
冷却时间无法降低到 0.2 秒以下。
该技能和部分位移技能共享冷却时间。
玩家与发条核心传送至目标位置；若发条核心不存在，则在传送的同时于目标位置附近召唤发条核心；随后，发条核心使用奴役之索链接周围 20 米内的敌人，上限 4 个。
奴役之索每链接1个敌人， -0.1 秒该技能的冷却时间，生效次数上限等同于最大链接数量。
details: 冷却时间 3.3 秒，不受充能点数影响
Cooldown cannot be reduced below 0.2s
This skill shares Cooldown with certain Mobility Skills

Teleports you and Clockwork Core to the target location. If Clockwork Core does not exist, summons Clockwork Core near the target location upon teleportation. Afterwards, Clockwork Core links to up to 4 enemies within 20m using Chains of Enslavement
-0.1s Cooldown for this skill for each enemy linked by Chains of Enslavement. Effective times limit equals Max Link Quantity

8318.name: Precise: Ice Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
15.6% additional Cold Damage
Gains 30 Focus Pts when dealing damage to Frostbitten enemies. Interval: 0.4 s.

Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, creates an Ice Storm that follows the character. When there are enemies inside the storm, consumes 45 Focus Pts every 0.5 s to generate Glacial Spikes that deal Spell Cold Damage to the enemies
For every 1% Focus Speed, +1% Focus Pts gained, up to +200%. The Ice Storm ends when Focus Pts drop to 0.
+4% additional damage for this skill

8319.name: Precise: Thunder Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
15.6% additional Lightning Damage

For every 2m moved, this skill gains 5 Focus Pts. Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, using a non-Mobility Attack Skill will consume all Focus Pts and trigger this skill, summoning a Thunderstrike that deals 1109% Weapon Attack Damage to all enemies within a certain area.
When triggered by a Melee Skill, the Thunderstrike attacks a fan-shaped area. When triggered by a Ranged Skill, the Thunderstrike attacks a square-shaped area.

8320.name: Precise: Flame Focus
simple: Activates Focus and gains a buff:
+9% additional Fire Damage
+15% chance to Ignite targets
Adds 2 - 2 Base Ignite Damage

This skill gains 15 Focus Pts when inflicting Ignite. Upon defeating an enemy, there is a 100% chance to consume 40 Focus Pts and trigger this skill on the enemy, dealing Secondary Fire Damage equal to 25% of their Max Life to enemies within 3m (not affected by bonuses).
Additionally increases this skill's area for each time Ignite has been inflicted recently.

+4% additional damage for this skill

When taking damage, +100% chance to count Max Elemental and Erosion Resistance as Effective Elemental and Erosion Resistance
-10% Max Elemental and Erosion Resistance
Lasts 4s
Generates three Frost Shields orbiting around you while this skill lasts, dealing 50-50 Spell Cold Damage
